title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ava Chen
description: Improve Dedicated autoscaler burst controls and utilization reporting for priority routing by adding token-bucket smoothing, per-priority throughput guarantees, more granular telemetry, and dashboard surfaces. Motivation: customers running mixed-priority fleets saw noisy utilization and burst exhaustion under transient traffic; existing reports aggregated across priorities making debugging hard. Changes include: 1) token-bucket smoothing algorithm tweak to reduce micro-burst drain across low-priority queues; 2) new per-priority throughput SLA knobs and admission counters; 3) emit new telemetry metrics (dedicated.autoscaler.priority_alloc, dedicated.autoscaler.burst_drain_ms, dedicated.autoscaler.tokenbucket_fill_rate) for per-route and per-fleet aggregation; 4) add utilization-reporting pipeline changes to compute 1m/5m/1h priority-level utilization and attach to fleet UI; 5) small scheduler refactor to expose reservation windows used by throughput guarantees; 6) migrations for stored config defaults and backward-compatibility shims for older Dedicated clusters. Includes end-to-end tests, migration notes, and dashboard JSON. Checklist: [x] unit tests; [x] integration tests; [x] e2e perf benchmark; [x] docs; [x] release notes. Linked Linear items: ENG-4512, ENG-4720.
